paragraphs: Friend, this one is HEAVY, so let's sit with it a minute. Israel got told to stop celebrating because they had been unfaithful to their God, and that unfaithfulness was not a small thing. The message says they had gone to Baal-peor and 'consecrated themselves to Shame,' and so they 'became as detestable as the thing they loved' (Hosea 9:10). You become what you give yourself to, and that is the lesson sitting right in the middle of this chapter.

Now look at how the LORD talks about the start of the relationship. He says, 'I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness' (Hosea 9:10). Grapes in the WILDERNESS, and nobody expects fruit out there, but He was delighted anyway. That makes the turn so sad, because the people He found with joy walked away from Him, and the message says plainly that God would reject them 'because they have not obeyed Him' (Hosea 9:17). I think this hurts because the love was real from the very first moment.

So what do I bake into your heart from this, baker? Obedience is not a side dish. It is what keeps a life connected to the One who gave it, and a root cut off from Him 'cannot bear fruit' (Hosea 9:16). Hold your loves loosely and test them against His Word. And hear this: the story isn't over, because the Word still has more to say.
